Theo: Ok last call for March Madness office bracket swap. Brackets lock at 6pm. Anyone still tweaking picks? :basketball:

Rina: Ugh I keep changing my Final Four. Also who added the upset multiplier rule? :eyes:

Luis: That was Ben. Upset multiplier x2 for any 12 over 5. Makes late swaps spicy.

Ben: Guilty. Makes the $2 pool interesting. Winner gets a $25 coffee card + custom crown (felt).

Hannah: Im in. But also can someone explain the tiebreaker? I always forget.

Theo: Tiebreaker is total points in the championship game (predict to nearest point). Add your prediction in the sheet.

BracketBot: Reminder: brackets lock in 45 minutes. Submit via https://tinyurl.com/rw-brackets or the Google sheet posted in-thread.

Rina: Quick poll: do we allow edits after first round starts? My vote: nope, freeze after lock.

Luis: Freeze. Keeps it fair.

Ben: Also proposing a bonus: best bracket name wins a donut. Names so far: "Net Gains", "Bracketology 2.0". Bring the puns.

Hannah: Hannah / Sweet Sweet Bracket / tiebreaker 142

Rina: Rina / Upset Diva / tiebreaker 137

Luis: Luis / Chalk Crusher / tiebreaker 144

Ben: Ben / Felt Crown Syndicate / tiebreaker 140

Theo: Theo / Last Minute Hero / tiebreaker 139

BracketBot: Entries received: 5. Brackets lock at 18:00 UTC (local 11:00am).

Rina: Also snack rota? If we do the live watch party for Final Four, I can grab pizza if someone brings plates.

Hannah: Ill bring plates + napkins. Vegan pizza ok?

Luis: I'll get the non-vegan pies. Ben will likely bring a weird specialty pizza because of course he will.

Ben: I bought a pear-gorgonzola last time. Promise to be less adventurous. Maybe.

Theo: Perfect. If anyone else wants in, pop your name in the sheet before lock. May the best bracket name (and bracket) win. :crown: :donut:
